name: Communication Style Analyzer
description: Analyzes your Teams chats and emails to build a reusable profile of your writing voice — greetings, tone, length, punctuation, sign-offs, common phrases, and quirks — and saves it to memory for other assistants to use.
author: Srinivas Varukala
coverImageAlt: Several paper-like communication rhythms pass through a cyan prism and become one distinctive waveform.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: many subtle communication rhythms are distilled into one distinctive reusable voice profile without revealing any message content
Scene/backdrop: an uncluttered slate acoustic studio with translucent warm-paper ribbons flowing through a cyan-lit analytical prism
Subject: varied abstract speech rhythms and punctuation-like curves enter separately, then emerge as one coherent layered waveform sculpture with a unique cadence
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; graceful convergence toward a clear central profile with negative space
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical; soft cyan edge light and subtle orange accent at the final profile
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: purely abstract rhythm forms with no readable communication content; no text, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI or Microsoft Fluent branding
